title: Concept: Kubernetes dashboard linked from a response
description: A link or reference to the Kubernetes dashboard or its API in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: The dashboard lists every workload, secret reference and service account in the cluster, and a link from an application page tells an attacker it exists and where to find it.
applicability: Cluster-level visibility is the first step to credential theft and lateral movement inside the cluster.
risk: An administrative console must never be discoverable from an application response.
